pull_request.title: Collapse duplicate pushes within a minute
pull_request.author: yuki-t

gate.reason: No finding was both proven by execution and severe enough to block.

findings.title: should_send() measures the one-minute window from the first push, not the last
findings.body_markdown: The key's TTL is set once on the first push (line 14) and never refreshed, so a burst that keeps arriving every 50 seconds sends a notification every minute.

severity.explanation: reachable from a public entrypoint × proven × file tested, symbol not × blast radius 0.20 × churn 0.15

findings.title: prune_seen() deletes every expired key in one SCAN loop
findings.body_markdown: The loop has no batch limit (line 38); on a large keyspace it blocks the worker.

severity.explanation: reachable internally × file tested, symbol not × unproven × blast radius 0.10 × churn 0.15

suppression.reason: The shared dedupe store is truncated nightly by the retention job, so a prune never sees more than a day of keys. Applies to every service on the shared helper.

findings.title: Guard `_dedupe_key()` against two callers running it at once
findings.body_markdown: Two workers running `_dedupe_key()` together could each overwrite the other's result.

findings.title: Add a regression test for `should_send()`
findings.body_markdown: No test exercises the path in `should_send()` that this change breaks.
